title: Mid-level Frontend Developer
description: Mid-level frontend engineer capable of independently delivering complex features, architecting state management, implementing robust TypeScript types, optimizing build pipelines, and ensuring test coverage.

skills.rationale: Deep knowledge of React hooks, component architecture, state management (Zustand/Redux), and client routing is central to daily delivery.
Writing generic utility functions, discriminating unions, and typing complex component props reliably.
Mastery of async programming (Promises, async/await), ES modules, prototypal mechanics, and error handling.
Writing integration tests with MSW, E2E tests with Playwright/Cypress, and automated accessibility checks.
Proficiency with CSS Grid, animations, fluid units (clamp), and scalable theming with custom properties.
Configuring Vite/Webpack bundlers, transpilation targets, and automating CI/CD pull request validation.
Understanding SSR lifecycle, hydration mechanics, efficient data fetching, and Next.js / Nuxt features.
Configuring CSP headers, secure token storage in cookies, CSRF protection, and image format optimization.
Deep understanding of browser rendering pipeline, WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility, and HTTP/2 concepts.

scoring.description: Each skill score is multiplied by its importance weight. Final score is sum divided by sum of weights.

not_ready.label: Not Ready
not_ready.description: Significant gaps in mid-level frontend architecture, state management, or TypeScript.

developing.label: Developing
developing.description: Competent with UI components, but needs guidance on complex state patterns, testing, and SSR.

approaching.label: Approaching Ready
approaching.description: Strong framework skills and type safety, moving towards full independence in architectural tasks.

ready.label: Ready
ready.description: Meets all mid-level expectations: delivers full-stack frontend features independently with tests and security best practices.

exceeds.label: Exceeds Expectations
exceeds.description: Exceeds mid-level expectations with advanced performance profiling and architecture leadership.
